hero.title: 633 Villas, Every Plot Explorable in 3D
hero.body: Buyers at Malfa Al-Assalah explore each of its 633 villas plot by plot on a Manzili 3D twin and showroom touch tables, with sales staff trained for family consultations.

sidebar: Malfa Al-Assalah · 633 villas on a 45,000+ m² site, within NHC's 3.85M+ m² Al-Assalah master community
Plot-level WebGL twin · 4K showroom touch tables · Sales team certification

challenge.title: Helping Families Tell Similar Villas Apart
challenge.body: Before construction starts, villa buyers in Southwest Riyadh need to understand plot privacy, sun angles and room sizes.

cards.title: Identical Floor Plans
cards.body: The same 2D plan across hundreds of plots confused families, delaying decisions and adding extra showroom visits.

cards.title: No Way to Check Sun and Privacy
cards.body: Saudi families weigh sunlight, courtyard privacy and street frontage carefully. Without daylight simulation, decisions stalled.

cards.title: Static Scale Models
cards.body: Acrylic models couldn't show interior variations, so teams struggled to explain finishes and layouts from printed sheets.

solution.title: An Interactive Sales Console for Riyadh Villa Buyers
solution.body: A plot-level WebGL twin runs on the showroom touch tables, backed by sales playbooks written for family consultations.

blocks.label: Pillar 01 · Digital Twin
blocks.title: Plot-Level WebGL Twin
blocks.body: A lightweight browser app lets buyers inspect each villa plot, checking courtyard boundaries, street access and nearby green spaces.

features.title: Plot Sun-Path Studies
features.body: Daylight from morning to evening on each plot

features.title: Interior Walkthroughs
features.body: From ground-floor living to private upper floors

features.title: No Download
features.body: Smooth 60 FPS on showroom and mobile

blocks.label: Pillar 03 · Showroom Hardware
blocks.title: 65-Inch Showroom Touch Consoles
blocks.body: 65-inch 4K touch tables in the Al-Assalah sales gallery let families gather around and explore their future home together.

features.title: Split-Screen Comparisons
features.body: Villa types and plot sizes side by side

features.title: Local Computing
features.body: No lag on zoom, rotate or interior views

blocks.label: Pillar 04 · Sales Enablement
blocks.title: Sales Coaching for Family Consultations
blocks.body: On-site coaching certified the developer's consultants to handle family objections step by step, from plot privacy to finishes.

features.title: Reservation Workflow
